Return to saved viewpoint exactly after deep-ground or orbital exploration.

Large elevation datasets trigger LOD/caching but not multi-second blocked user input.
Reduced-motion mode eliminates involuntary zoom tunnel and long camera easing.

Open-ended future world date cannot be labeled observed weather.
Create a solid from dimensions; computed volume, density and mass agree analytically.

Unknown underground detail rendered as uncertain/not mapped rather than invented real-world infrastructure.
